detail.longDescription:
Traefik v3.7.12 deprecates the previously introduced underscoreHeadersStrategy
entrypoint option and introduces a new one called aliasHeadersStrategy that
rejects even more potentially spoofed headers - not just with underscores.
Reminder to adjust your Traefik config. Add an entry point option to handle
request headers with aliasing names by rtribotte · Pull Request #13720 ·
traefik/traefik [https://github.com/traefik/traefik/pull/13720]
